name: October 15, 2024 Regular Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  OCTOBER 15, 2024
  MULTIPURPOSE ROOM
  6:30 P.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Commissioner Guldimann called the meeting to order at 6:39 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Commissioners Georgia Goldfarb, Suzanne Guldimann, and Jake Lingo

  ABSENT: Chair Dane Skophammer and Vice Chair Alicia Peak

  ALSO PRESENT: Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director; Rob Duboux, Public
  Works Director; Kate Manisco, Recreation Manager; and Brittany Saleaumua,
  Administrative Assistant

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Commissioner Guldimann led the Pledge of Allegiance.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Commissioner Goldfarb moved, and Commissioner Lingo seconded a motion to
  approve the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried 3-0; Chair
  Skophammer and Vice Chair Peak absent.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported the agenda for the meeting was
  posted on October lO, 2024.

ITEM 1  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  None.

ITEM 2  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  None.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

MOTION  Commissioner Goldfarb moved, and Commissioner Lingo seconded a motion to
  approve the consent calendar. The question was called, and the motion carried 3-0;
  Chair Skophammer and Vice Chair Peak absent.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:
  A.  PreviouslV Discussed Items
  None.
  B.  New Items
  1.  Approval of Minutes
  Recommended Action: Approve the minutes for the August 20, 2024 Parks
  and Recreation Commission Regular meeting.
  2.  Community Services Department Monthlv Report
  Recommended Action: Receive and file a report of activities, events,
  proj ects, and programs coordinated by the Community Services Department
  in August and September 2024.

ITEM 4  OLD BUSINESS

  None.

ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Capital Improvement Proiects and Park Maintenance Improvements
  Recommended Action: Receive and file a report on the Capital Improvement
  Projects and maintenance improvements for City parks and facilities.

  Community Services Director Riesgo introduced Public Works Director Rob
  Duboux and presented the staff report.

  In response to Commissioner Goldfarb, Public Works Director Duboux stated the
  Charmlee Nature Center project would be initiated in Spring 2025. He stated the
  Legacy Park retention basin was fllled with recycled water.

  In response to Commissioner Goldfarb, Community Services Director Riesgo
  stated maintenance staff were working on a planting project that would fill the area
  between the Malibu Bluffs Park parking lot and the Michael Landon Center.

  In response to Commissioner Lingo, Public Works Director Duboux stated the
  Parks and Recreation Commission and community would provide feedback on the
  Permanent Snack Shack design and staff were working with the Contractor to
  finalize the timeline.

  In response to Commissioner Goldfarb, Community Services Director Riesgo
  stated solar panels would be considered for the Permanent Snack Shack design.

  B.  Dog Park Rules
  Recommended Action: 1) Review the Trancas Dog Park Facility Rules; and 2)
  Provide feedback to staff.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  Commissioner Guldimann stated food-aggressive dogs should not be at the dog
  “No aggressive dogs” and “Any
  park. She stated the rules,  person utilizing the dog
  park does so at their own  risk,” would apply to all visitors. She recommended the
  Commission to note the concem, but would not recommend changing or adding a
  new rule.

  Commissioners Goldfarb and Lingo indicated agreement with Commissioner
  Guldimann.

CONSENSUS
  By Consensus, the Commission would not change the Trancas Dog Park Facility
  Rules.

ITEM 6  STAFF UPDATES

  Recreation Manager Manisco provided an update on Fall Programs, the Skate Park
  banner featuring Olympic silver medalist Tom Schaar, and Malibu Elementary fleld
  Slgnage.

  Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on the Special Joint
  Meeting with the Malibu Arts Commission and the November and December
  Commission meetings.

ITEM 7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS AND INQUIRIES

  Commissioner Lingo thanked the staff for finishing the scoreboard project and
  appreciated their support.

  Commissioner Goldfarb stated she wanted the City to commit to removing non-
  native invasive plants from city properties.

  Commissioner Guldimann appreciated staff for their work.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  None.
